inputs.text: DHS is turning one arrest into a political weapon against New York City’s sanctuary policies, casting immigrant communities as dangerous without providing evidence here to support that broad claim. That kind of rhetoric shifts attention away from the real issue: whether federal authorities are using an isolated case to weaken local protections and widen immigration enforcement. Public safety matters, but it cannot justify treating whole communities as suspect because of immigration status. We should protect people’s rights rather than let fear become a pretext for expanding state power.
